name: Insulation monitoring relay
summary: Relay that continuously checks insulation resistance of an unearthed (IT) system to earth and alarms on a first fault.
description: An insulation monitoring relay is connected between the conductors of an unearthed (IT) system and earth, and injects a measuring signal to determine insulation resistance. It warns when insulation falls below its setting so a first fault can be located before a second fault causes a trip.

The symbol shows the device and its connections but not the measuring method, which matters on systems with drives or large DC components. Only one insulation monitor should normally be active on a galvanically connected system, so the drawing should show any disconnection or interlock between parallel systems.
readingNotes: Check that only one monitor is active on each connected IT system.
Identify alarm outputs and test button wiring.
distinction: An insulation monitoring relay measures insulation resistance of an unearthed system; a residual current monitor measures leakage current in an earthed system.
